rendered_value: Meridian Health System operates as an integrated health system and health plan anchored on Epic Hyperspace, Clarity, and Caboodle, with a fragmented on-premise analytics estate spanning SQL Server, Tableau, Power BI, and SAS. An outsourced analytics managed services provider consumes an estimated 80% of delivery capacity on maintenance, leaving minimal bandwidth for net-new strategic work. AWS and Databricks represent the target platform direction — neither is production-ready, and no certified medallion architecture has been evidenced. Ten-plus executive stakeholder groups — CEO, CFO, CIO, CDAO, CMO, Chief Experience Officer, Health Plan Operations, Privacy, Procurement, and the Program Office — have each confirmed seven enterprise use cases as strategic priorities: unified clinical and claims lakehouse, governed AI/LLM foundation, call center optimization, provider quality and performance, end-to-end cost transparency, payment integrity and leakage reduction, and automated close and reporting. Every use case is in planning stage. None has reached decision grade. The four pervasive blockers — no certified medallion architecture, no formal data governance operating model, no certified semantic layer, and no patient/member identity spine — must be resolved before Nexus can produce sourcing-event outputs or quantified value claims. The executive decision now is: which evidence closure to fund first, and who owns accountability for each gap.
